meta.title: Event reasoning — CatalogueEntryView
meta.description:
## Event → field reasoning — CatalogueEntryView (Member-facing; distinct from Librarian's TitleDetailsView by design — different audience/query shape)

- **BookTitleAdded** → sets titleId, title, author, genre, coverImageUrl, publicationYear (row appears)
- **BookTitleDetailsUpdated** → overrides title/author/genre/coverImageUrl/publicationYear
- **BookTitleArchived** → removes the row from this list entirely (membership change, no field it 'sets')

Reused (via forward READMODEL→SCREEN edges) by both Catalogue Browse and Book Details — same underlying query, filtered to one row for Book Details.
